description: This file defines the Controller class in the OpenCart system, acting as a base class that manages registry entries and provides magic methods for property access.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Base controller class that manages a registry object and provides property overloading methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller with a Registry object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the registry by key, throws an exception if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the registry.
